## 改动 / Change

说明问题及修改后的行为。Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## 验证 / Validation

列出实际运行的检查与结果；未验证的环境请明确说明。
List checks actually run and their results; identify environments not verified.

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] 与改动相关的检查 / Checks relevant to this change
- [ ] 文案同时更新中文与英文 / Text changes cover Chinese and English
- [ ] 不含密钥、私人文件或资料库 / No credentials, personal files or profiles
